# Client asset work

Read the [asset library guide](../../client-mod/assets/README.md) and the
[client deployment procedure](../../docs/operations/client-assets.md).
Keep editable artwork, generation inputs and required attribution together.
Preserve the existing Mod Tools installation's custom build files.

Before game-control or capture work, read the private operator instructions
identified by the root AGENTS.md. Use game-only observation, prepare file/build
work before capture, keep the control phase brief, and release immediately.
Preserve the player's session and settings; never terminate their game to
capture or deploy assets. If game-only observation cannot be established,
hand capture to the player.

The draft coding guidelines remain inactive.
